input_formulas.threat_candidates: Component list +0x280..+0x288; flags+0x14 bit4 clear AND (bit1 set OR (bit0 clear AND flags+0x10 bit28 set AND bit19 clear))
input_formulas.support_candidates_for_B: Same list, bit2 set AND bit4 clear
input_formulas.A: For each eligible threat t: h0=R(weighted_P(t,self_position),Q(self)); H=h0+sum_s R(weighted_P(t,s.position),Q(self)); if H>0, accumulate (h0/H)*h0. Note Q(self) is reused for every s.
input_formulas.weight: weighted_P = P * (2-min(distance_helper(position,t.position)/t.range,2)) * (1-clamp(convert_counter(now-t.timestamp)/60,0,1)); preserve float operation order in an implementation
